FALCONER-FALCONERS_GLOVE.title: Falconer's Glove
FALCONER-FALCONERS_GLOVE.description: Shows the falcon's [gold]Level[/gold] (max 10). The falcon gains XP from each won combat (elites 3, bosses 5). Each Level makes [gold]Errands[/gold] 10% stronger. Rest sites get [gold]Fly[/gold]: pick a Trait.
FALCONER-FALCONERS_GLOVE.flavor: Well-worn leather, scarred by a hundred landings.
FALCONER-GILDED_HOOD.title: Gilded Hood
FALCONER-GILDED_HOOD.description: As Falconer's Glove. The first [gold]Errand[/gold] each combat resolves twice. +1 XP per combat.
FALCONER-GILDED_HOOD.flavor: Gold thread, and a bird that knows its worth.
FALCONER-LEATHER_LURE.title: Leather Lure
FALCONER-LEATHER_LURE.flavor: Swing it twice and she's back.
FALCONER-SILVER_BELLS.title: Silver Bells
FALCONER-SILVER_BELLS.description: Your first [gold]Errand[/gold] of 2 or more turns each combat is 1 turn faster.
FALCONER-SILVER_BELLS.flavor: You always hear where she is.
FALCONER-FALCON_PERCH.title: Falcon Perch
FALCONER-FALCON_PERCH.description: Whenever you enter a rest site, the falcon gains [blue]2[/blue] XP.
